summary: Eshallgo Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of separate class A and class B shareholder meetings and an extraordinary general meeting held on May 6, 2026. Shareholders approved a proposal to increase the voting rights attached to each class B ordinary share from 50 to 400 votes per share. The measure passed with 100% support from class B holders and 100% support from class A holders present. No financial terms, price, premium, or transactional event were involved. This is a routine corporate governance change with no special-situation M&A or capital event.
